en.headline: Chief Executive holds first dialogue exchange with LegCo members
en.dek: John Lee shared experience on the practice of patriots administering Hong Kong during a closed-door session designed to deepen mutual understanding between the executive and legislature.
body: Chief Executive John Lee on Tuesday morning held the first dialogue exchange meeting with members of the Legislative Council at the LegCo Complex banquet hall. The session lasted about one and a half hours and was closed to the media.

According to official arrangements, Lee first spoke on his experience implementing the principle of patriots administering Hong Kong. An open discussion then followed with no fixed agenda, covering national, Hong Kong and international affairs as well as work experience. Key government officials including the Chief Secretary and Secretaries of Departments also attended.

The meeting forms part of efforts to strengthen communication and consensus between the executive and the legislature. Officials have described the format as allowing more direct and flexible exchanges compared with existing platforms such as the Chief Executive’s Question and Answer Session and the antechamber exchange meetings.

zh.headline: 李家超與立法會議員舉行首次對談交流會
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超於閉門會議中分享「愛國者治港」實踐體會，會議旨在增進行政立法互相了解及共識。
body: 行政長官李家超星期二早上在立法會綜合大樓宴會廳，與立法會議員舉行首次對談交流會，會議為時約一個半小時，以閉門形式進行。
按照安排，李家超首先分享他對「愛國者治港」的實踐體會，其後開放對談，議題不設限制，可涵蓋國家、香港及國際事務，以至工作心得。政務司司長及各司局長等主要官員亦有出席。
是次會議屬於加強行政立法溝通的一部分。當局形容此形式可讓雙方進行更直接、靈活的交流，有別於現有的行政長官互動交流答問會及前廳交流會等平台。
